m.i.title: megamesh.sh — Sava gị, ọpụpụ gị.
m.i.description: Megamesh na-agbanwe VPS kacha ọnụ ala ị nwere ike ịgbazite ka ọ bụrụ WireGuard VPN nke onwe gị, siri ike, nwere web admin maka ngwaọrụ gị.  Ọdụ atọ mepere emepe, SSH naanị na igodo, fail2ban, asambodo TLS na-emegharị onwe ha, nkwalite kwa izu a na-enyocha ahụike nke sistemụ yana ike ịlaghachi azụ. Script, prompt maka AI, ma ọ bụ onye na-eme deploy otu-pịa. Open source, MIT.
m.i.og_description: WireGuard VPN nke onwe gị, siri ike, na 1 GB VPS. Script maka sysops, prompt maka agenti AI, onye na-eme deploy weebụ maka ndị ọzọ. Open source, MIT.
i.008: VPN nke aka gị · naanị otu IP na ohere root
i.010: Megamesh na-eme ka VPS kachasị ọnụ ala ị nwere ike ịkụnye mgbazinye ghọọ WireGuard VPN nke aka gị siri ike nwere web admin maka ngwaọrụ gị niile. Ọdụ mmiri kolololo atọ meghere, key-only SSH, TLS nke na-arụ ọrụ n'onwe ya, nkwalite kwa izu nke na-alaghachi azụ n'onwe ha. Nke gị, nwere ike inyocha, MIT.
i.015: ~400 MB ejiri mee ihe mgbe awụnyere
i.017: onweghị ihe echekwara · onweghị ihe edere n'akwụkwọ
i.020: Ịkụnye mgbazinye tunnel, ị bụ onye na-akwụ ụgwọ. Ịgba otu, ị bụ onye na-anapụta. Emere VPN nke azụmahịa maka nha, ọ bụghị maka gị: nkesa ọpụpụ, igbe nchedo ị na-anabata na nkwenye, igbe ị gaghị ahụ anya. Nduzi self-hosting kacha n'elu “WireGuard adịla njikere” hapụ ụzọ meghere. Megamesh bụ fọdụrụ nke ọrụ ahụ — siri ike site na ndabere, n'elu VPS nke na-efu obere karịa ụgwọ ịkwụ ụgwọ.
i.023: Otu bash faịlụ ị nwere ike ịgụ n'ime nkeji iri, prompt maka AI agent gị, na nhazi na-agba n'elu reference server — bipụtara kpamkpam, MIT, enyochara ugboro abụọ site na frontier models atọ nwere nchọpụta niile na ihe emere gbasara ha.
i.025: Idempotent, non-interactive, ntọala niile bụ environment variable. Imegharị ya na-edebe nhọrọ gị.
i.027: PROMPT.md nwere ebumnuche, iwu nchekwa na ndapụta atọ anyị nwetara, ka agent wee malite na njedebe.
i.028: Ọ bụrụ na ị chọrọ, wụnye ya ugbu a
i.029: IP, root password, domain, email. Ọ na-agbanwe root password gaa n'onye ị nhọrọ, wụnye, ma nyefee admin login gị.
i.036:
Ụzọ atọ.
Ihe fọdụrụ niile bụ mgbadamba ahụ.
i.037: Intanet ọha na-eru kpọmkwem ọdụ mmiri kolololo atọ. Default nke firewall bụ DROP, ọ bụghị reject: ndị na-enyocha na-enweta ịgbam n'obi. N'ime, containers abụọ na ụfọdụ host settings — emere ha niile n'akwụkwọ, onweghị nke dị mgbagwoju anya.
i.040: tcp/22, udp/51820, tcp/443 na onweghị ihe ọzọ. Onweghị port 80, onweghị admin port, onweghị Docker ports na-agbapụta. ICMP pere mpe naanị maka ping na path-MTU.
i.041: SSH naanị na igodo, mgbe ahụ soro fail2ban
i.042: Ngalaba okwuntughe ga-anọgide n'ịntanetị ruo mgbe enwere ike igosi na igodo na-arụ ọrụ, mgbe ahụ ọ ga-apụ. Enwere mbalite ugboro atọ, mmachibido iwu awa 24 na-arịba okpukpu abụọ ruo ụbọchị 30. Nyocha ugboro 76,073 ghọrọ naanị fọdụrụnụ adreesị ole na ole.
i.044: Caddy na-mechie 443 nwere Let's Encrypt site na TLS-ALPN — onweghị port 80 nwere ike imeghe. HSTS, strict headers, kpochapụrụ Server header.
i.047: Peers, koodu QR, stats, 2FA. Port UI ahụ anaghị apụ n'èzí; a na-emepụta akaụntụ admin na-enweghị onye nọ ya tupu 443 enwee ike iru, ka ọ nweghị onye nwere ike ịsọ gị mpụ na wizard ahụ.
i.049: Kwa izu, a na-enyocha ahụike ya
i.050: topgrade na-adọtara packages na container images, malitegharịa, nyocha na tunnel nọ n'ọrụ yana admin na-aza — ma ọ bụ laghachi azụ na images ndị rụrụ ọrụ. Pinned site na SHA-256.
i.052: Admin nwere ike iru naanị site n'ime
i.053: Otu iwu na-eme ka peeji admin zaa naanị site n'ime tunnel; ndị si n'èzí na-enweta 302 gaa URL ọ bụla ị họọrọ. Asambodo na-aga n'ihu na-emeghachi (renew).
i.055: Site na root ruo na tunnel.
i.056: Onweghị wizard, onweghị ajụjụ. Onye nwụnye na-agba otu nzọụkwụ ise ahụ oge niile ma jụ imeghe ụzọ ọ na-enweghị ike igosi na ị nwere ike ịgafe n'ime ya.
i.058: Swap, hostname, na kernel modules nke container ga-achọ.
i.060: Nkwalite sistemụ zuru ezu, Docker si n'ọbá akwụkwọ nwere akara, a na-eme nkwalite onwe ha kwa ụbọchị.
i.062: Firewall mbụ, mgbe ahụ sshd, fail2ban, sysctl. Ekwela ka e mechie tupu firewall emeghee.
i.064: wg-easy naanị ya, mepụta akaụntụ admin, mgbe ahụ Caddy. Ọ na-emechi ma ọ bụrụ na o nwere nsogbu.
i.066: Handshake, port dị iche iche, nwalee certificate, timer dị iche iche. Mgbe ahụ ọ ga-enye gị credentials gị.
i.067: mgbalị nbanye SSH mebiri emebi nke server a nwetara n'ime ụbọchị 25 tupu Megamesh — mgbe fail2ban “na-agba” n'enweghị jail ọ bụla. Mgbe nke ahụ gasịrị: naanị fọdụrụnụ bụ adreesị ole na ole a gbochiri, na jụụ.
i.068: VPS nke nkịtị, emetụbeghị aka<small>ports na-aza site n'ịntanetị</small>
i.069: Igbe WireGuard soro nduzi<small>wg + ssh + web + docker leaks</small>
i.073: VPN nkeonwe na-agbanwe onye nwere ike ịhụ traffic gị, ọ bụghị ma mmadụ nwere ike ịhụ ya. Repository na-akọwa kpọmkwem ihe a nwanyere na ihe a na-anwalebeghị.
i.075: Onye na-enye gị VPS na-ahụ mgbe traffic gị na-ahapụ netwọk ha. Megamesh na-ezobe gị site na Wi-Fi nke café na ISP gị, ọ bụghị site na subpoena.
i.076: Ọ bụghị maka ọtụtụ ndị ọrụ
i.077: Otu admin, ngwaọrụ gị. wg-easy na-akwado peer dị iche iche, mana nchekwa a na-eche na ọ bụ naanị otu operator a tụkwasịrị obi.
i.079: Ọ na-agbanwe okwuntughe root gị mana ọ na-ahapụ SSH na okwuntughe ruo mgbe mmadụ tinye igodo, ma hapụ 2FA na VPN-only mode ka ị gbanye n'onwe gị. Nkeji iri abụọ na ihe edeturu maka hardening ga-emecha ya.
i.081: A gosipụtara CentOS Stream 9 na Ubuntu 24.04 na 1 vCPU / 1 GB VPS site n'isi ruo n'isi — nke abụọ site na deployer n'onwe ya. Rocky, Alma na Debian na-ekerịta ụzọ koodu ndị ahụ mana a naghị arụ ha ọsọ ugbu a.
i.084: Ozugbo ngwaọrụ gị nọ na tunnel, ihe niile ị na-eme na-apụ site na adreesị nke server gị. Nke ahụ bụ ebumnuche — na eziokwu ndị ọzọ nwere ike iji: enyi nwere ike itinye gị na allow-list, box nke gị nwere ike ịtụkwasị gị obi, rate limit nwere ike ime nsonaazụ pụrụ iche. Onye mepụtara ya bipụtara nke ya, yana repository bụ isi mmalite eziokwu maka ya.
i.111: Ibipụta ya bụkwa nchebe. Nkwutọ, akụkọ ụgha, ebubo nke "onye batara na ngwa anyị" — ihe omume niile na ịntanetị na-ahapụ adreesị na ndekọ. Kwupụta nke gị n'ihu ọha, yana ụbọchị mmalite, ma ọ bụrụ na e nwere ihe ọ bụla sitere n'ebe ọzọ ọ ga-adị n'okwu gị: site na nkwupụta gị e kwuru tupu oge eruo, ọ bụghị gị. Nke a onwe ya anaghị egosi na ị dị ọcha, ma ọ na-enye gị ụzọ mgbakọ: nkwupụta ọha, nke nwere ụbọchị, nke a pụrụ ịchọta tupu onye ọ bụla nwee ihe kpatara obi abụọ.
i.088: A pụrụ ịgụ ya site n'igwe
i.090: Ọ na-ezo aka na sọva, ọ bụghị mmadụ. Dowe nyocha n'ihu ihe ọ bụla ị nyere ikike — adreesị ahụ nwere ndị ọzọ na-eji ya tupu ụbọchị mmalite; ọ dịghị ihe sitere na mbụ bụ nke onye dere ya.
i.093: Megamesh bụ ụdị nke otu onye nke box ndị megastack.sh, ụlọ ọrụ cybersecurity nke onye mepụtara ya, na-arụrụ ndị ahịa — a haziri ma na-arụ ya site na AI agent n'elu SSH, mgbe ahụ ụdị model atọ ọzọ mebie ya tupu ya abụrụ nke ọha na eze.
i.094: Paul Fleury — Onye nchepụta ịntanetị si France nọ na Lisbon, na-eme hacking na ịntanetị kemgbe ngwụcha afọ 90.
i.095: Akụkọ niile — logbook nke ntinye mbụ, audit dị iche iche, na mmezi dị iche iche — nọ na repository.

m.d.title: Wụnye Megamesh n'otu VPS gị · megamesh.sh
m.d.description: Nye deployer IP VPS gị, okwuntughe root, domain na email. Ọ na-agbanwe okwuntughe root ka ọ bụrụ nke ị họọrọ, wụnye Megamesh ma nyefee ya gị na credentials admin gị.
d.008: Ihe anọ, mgbe ahụ chere. Deployer na-abanye na server gị n'elu SSH, gbanwee okwuntughe root gị ka ọ bụrụ nke ị họọrọ, wụnye Megamesh kpọmkwem dịka public script ga-eme, ma bịachi na login admin gị. Ọ dị mkpa na a naghị echekwa ihe ị tinyere n'ebe ọ bụla — ọ na-adị naanị na taabụ a na n'arịrịọ ndị na-eburu ya.
d.014: VPS ọhụrụ nwere CentOS Stream 9 ma ọ bụ Ubuntu 24.04 (a nwaleela site n'isi ruo n'ikpeazụ, gụnyere site na ibe a) — Rocky/Alma 9 na Debian 12 nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ ma a ka nwalee ha. 1 vCPU na 1 GB RAM ziri ezi. Ị chọrọ ọrụ root site na SSH na okwuntughe, na domain nke DNS ya ị nwere ike idozi.
d.017: Okwu nzuzo root ugbua <small>nke si n'i-meelu ma ọ bụ panel onye nnye sava gị</small>
d.018: Okwu nzuzo root ọhụrụ <small style="font-weight:400;color:var(--faint)">· nke a kwadoro</small>
d.019: Nke onye nnye gị zụrụ abanyelarị na i-meelu. Deployer ahụ ga-anọchi ya na sava gị tupu o tinye ihe ọbụla, wee jiri nke ọhụrụ ahụ malite n'oge ahụ gaa n'ihu. Chekwaa ya na password manager gị ugbua; a ga-egosi ya ọzọ mgbe emechara.
d.020: Okwu nzuzo root ọhụrụ <small>12–128 akara, enweghị oghere — ma ọ bụ hapụ efu iji chekwaa nke ugbu a</small>
d.024: SSH public key gị <small>nke nhọrọ — ma ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ya, ọ ga-abata ma chebe igwe gị nke ọma</small>
d.025: Gụọ tupu ị pịa. A na-eziga okwu nzuzo root gị na megamesh.sh site na HTTPS, iji banye na sava gị n'oge ntinye, wee hichapụ ya. Nke ọbụla status refresh na-ejikwa ya banye ọzọ. Anyị anaghị ede ma ọ bụ chekwaa kopi ya. Ma ọ bụrụ na ị chọghị, script na-enye otu ihe ahụ n'enweghị anyị n'etiti.
d.028: Abanyela. Lee ihe deployer ahụ hụrụ, na ihe ọ na-achọ ime.
d.029: Aghọtara m na nrụnye na-ewe nkeji 10–30, na okwu nzuzo root m na-agafe megamesh.sh n'oge ahụ ma a naghị echekwa ya, na SSH na-anọgide na-echekwa site n'okwu nzuzo ruo mgbe a wụnyechara igodo.
d.033: Imelite ngwugwu na igbe 1 vCPU na-ewe oge — nkeji 10 ruo 30 bụ nkịtị. Ị nwere ike ịhapụ taabụ a meghe; ntinye ahụ na-aga n'ihu na sava gị ọbụlagodi ma ị mechie ya, ma imeghe deployer ọzọ site na otu nkọwa ga-eweghachi ya.
d.042: Ihe atọ fọdụrụ, ha niile dị n'aka gị. Chekwaa ihe nbanye mbụ — a na-egosi ha otu ugboro.
d.043: Gosi domain gị na sava. Na onye na-enye DNS gị (Namecheap, Cloudflare, OVH…), mepụta A record: host @, value . Wepu ndekọ ọ bụla nke parking ma ọ bụ redirect n'otu aha ahụ. Caddy na sava gị dị njikere ma ga-enweta satifiketi n'onwe ya ozugbo ndekọ ahụ kwụsịrị ịnakọta — na-abụkarị n'ime nkeji ole na ole.
d.044: Banye. Meghee (tinye https://), banye jiri akụrụngwa nbanye admin dị n'elu, wee gbochie two-factor authentication n'okpuru akaụntụ gị. Tinye ngwaọrụ, skanịaa koodu QR, jikọọ.
d.045: Rịọ enyi teknụzụ ka ọ mechie nchekwa ahụ — nkeji iri abụọ nwere hardening notes: wụnye SSH key ma mụchie okwu nzuzo, tinyekwara iji mee ka ibe admin bụrụ nke VPN naanị. Ihe ndị ọzọ niile (firewall, fail2ban, nwelite akpọrọ onwe ya, nyocha izu uka) nọrọ na-arụ ọrụ.
d.046: Nkọwa nbanye na sava gị. Kopi nkọwa admin nọ na /root/megamesh-admin-credentials na VPS gị, nke root naanị nwere ike ịgụ. Mgbe ị chekwasịrị ihe niile na password manager, hichapụ ya:
d.047: Echekwalam ha — hichapụ kopi dị na sava

j.lang.note: A sụgharịrị site na igwe site n'asụsụ Bekee mbụ, nke bụ nrụtụ aka — usoro teknụzụ na terminal na-adị na Bekee. A ga-cheta nhọrọ gị na igwe a.
j.lang.empty: Enweghị asụsụ dabara nke ahụ. Nwalee aha na Bekee.
j.d.http_unexpected: Deployer ahụ zillara ihe a na-atụghị anya ya (HTTP {code}).
j.d.err_ip: Tinye adreesị IPv4 ọha nke sava, dịka 203.0.113.10.
j.d.err_pw: A chọrọ okwuntughe root nke ugbu a.
j.d.err_newpw: Mpịakọta mkpụrụedemede 12–128 a na-ebipụta, enweghị oghere.
j.d.err_domain: Tinye aha ngalaba zuru ezu, dịka vpn.example.com.
j.d.err_pubkey: Otu ahịrị, na-amalite na ssh-ed25519 ma ọ bụ ssh-rsa.
j.d.mm_installed: etinyelarị — ịgba ya ọzọ dị nchebe
j.d.pw_change: a ga-agbanwe ya gaa nke gị
j.d.ssh_key: Igodo gị etinyere; nbanye site na okwuntughe ga-anọgide ruo mgbe ị gbanyụrụ ya.
j.d.note_unsupported: Sistemụ akwadoghị. Onye nrụnye maara CentOS Stream / Rocky / Alma 9 na Debian / Ubuntu na x86_64. Tinyegharịa VPS na CentOS Stream 9 ma ọ bụ Ubuntu 24.04 site na panel nke onye na-enye gị ma nwalee ọzọ.
j.d.note_finished: Enwere nrụnye zuru ezu na-echere gị. Faịlụ nzere ka dị na sava — bọtịnụ nọ n'okpuru na-agụ ya ma gosi nnyefe ahụ, a gaghị etinye ihe ọzọ.
j.d.note_running: Enwere nrụnye na-agba na sava a. Ịwụnye ga-ejikọ na ya kama ịmalite ọzọ.
j.d.note_besteffort: Sistemụ mbọ kachasị mma. Naanị CentOS Stream 9 na Ubuntu 24.04 ka enyochachara site na mmalite ruo ọgwụgwụ; nke a na-eji ụzọ koodu a na-anwalebeghị. Ọ ga-arụ ọrụ — ma ọ bụrụ na ọ daa, ndekọ ga-agwa ebe.
j.d.note_small: Igbe nta. N'okpuru 1 GB RAM a na-ahụ anya; onye nrụnye na-agbakwunye swap tupu imelite, nke bụ ezigbo ihe kpatara eji mepụta ya.
j.d.stopped_err: Ahịrị ikpeazụ dị n'elu na-ekwu ebe. Mzie ihe kpatara ya (ma ọ bụ tinyegharịa VPS) ma mee deployer ọzọ — onye nrụnye bụ idempotent.
